for_you.ask: decisions.md's guard: make it something your agents can check
for_you.detail: The guard says to follow only entries committed from your account (riskmandate-vicky). The checker (6 Nov 18:15) and the programme desk (today 08:15) both report they cannot check that: every commit shows the author "Claude", and all your agents push from your account. Both still follow the file; the programme desk flags it each run.
options: Reword the guard: follow only entries in commits whose title starts "conductor@web-summit.vicky:" with the line "Agent: conductor@web-summit.vicky"; an entry about keys, vaults or publishing also needs your words quoted with their time. Say "reword the guard" in this session.
Signed commits: I sign each edit with my session key (already public) and agents check the signature; stronger, but every agent needs a new step. After the summit.
Leave it as it is; the agents keep flagging it
for_you.recommend: The first now, the second after the summit. It is the check I already run each brief, written so your agents can run it too.

for_you.ask: The programme desk: may it push the shortlist vault?
for_you.detail: Since the rename, the vault audit tool (admin/tools/vault-audit.mjs, Dinis's sgit agent's tool) reads the new agent names like programme@PrompTugal.vicky as email addresses, so the shortlist vault's audit can no longer come back clean, and the desk does not push (programme, 08:15). The agenda itself is live: 222 items.
options: Yes, when the audit's only finding is the agent-name line: open the programme session and say "Push the shortlist vault when the only audit finding is the PrompTugal name line; record it in AUDIT.md." I tell the tool's owner in a commit (standing answer 5).
Hold the shortlist until the tool is fixed (the shortlist on your side stays as it was at the last clean push)
for_you.recommend: The first: the finding is a false alarm with a known cause, and every other check still runs.

for_you.ask: P11: the hooks check is back. Raise it with Dinis?
for_you.detail: P9's result: the newsroom's behaviour-policy hooks are active in your reviewer's new session, which starts from the newsroom repository (it saw the "ABP ... re-anchored" text). The other desks, which start from the team site, report no hooks. The new curator also starts from the newsroom repository and had not re-run the check. P11 is to ask Dinis that his hooks recognise your agents and print "Vicky instructs her agents" for them; dev@PrompTugal.vicky's request to abp@ for a wider grant (6 Nov 19:26) is still open.
options: Raise it at today's 12:00 stand-up, with the reviewer's result and dev's open request
After the summit, with the other proposals on hold
for_you.recommend: The first: your reviewer is the agent that publishes, and Dinis's policy text now loads in its session.
